summary.description: Tenpower identifies INR18650-30XG as a 3.0Ah 18650 cell with a 45A application-table maximum, while its available specification sheet states 40A maximum continuous discharge. Battery Mooch independently tested January 2026 cells and estimated about 40A continuous current, while noting the samples appeared pre-production because they lacked the CCC logo. The conservative 40A value is the defensible catalog candidate; treat the no-CCC samples and future production wrappers as separate evidence. This record preserves exact-model evidence and unresolved revision caveats for the canonical catalog entry.
highlights: Exact model identity is documented; wrapper and revision continuity remain relevant.
The conservative 40A value is supported by both the available specification sheet and exact-model vaping testing.
The tested cells appeared pre-production because they lacked the CCC logo; production continuity remains a caveat.
Runtime catalog admission is recorded separately from editorial visibility.
The catalog entry retains its measured and specification limits; default visibility remains a separate editorial decision.

claims.statement: The exact product identity is Tenpower INR18650-30XG (INR18650-30XG), as named by the product source and exact-model test.
